qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the battery positive connection point in the power distributor?
What screw type is used for the wiring harness on distributor connection?
What is the torque value for the wiring harness on distributor (2AZ)?
Which component types are specified for the battery positive connection point (1AZ)?
What is the component designation for the wiring harness on distributor?
Under which section are these wire to starter specifications listed?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12-10 Engine Electrical Equipment, subsection 12.42 Wires to starter.

qa_pairs.question: What unit of measurement is used for all torque specifications on this page?
How many different torque specifications are shown for wires to starter connections?
qa_pairs.answer: Two torque specifications are shown: 20 Nm and 10 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque values between the battery positive connection and the wiring harness connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The battery positive connection requires 20 Nm while the wiring harness connection requires 10 Nm, a difference of 10 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: Which connection point has the higher torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The battery positive connection point in power distributor (1AZ) has the higher torque specification at 20 Nm.
